name: p7_photos
notes: 50 room photos from Wikimedia Commons for P7 (spec 9.5, 11.2): bedrooms 13, living rooms 10, other rooms 9 (hallway, balcony, terrace, studio, rooms under works), not a room 7 (building fronts, an object, floor plans, a 3D render), bathrooms 6, kitchens 5; 9 with readable text, 5 with people, 5 dark, 5 in poor condition. CC0, public domain, CC BY or CC BY-SA, source and author per photo. Images are not in the repository (D-069). Labelled from the blurred copies by a model-based annotator (guide eval/datasets/guides/p7_photos.md), 20% re-labelled blind, 8 labels adjudicated.
